difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the article's lem (5l10) (source0.tex lines 852-854, source label 5l10). The statement reads: lem 5l10 Let n be even and a and b be antipodal vertices in the circulant graph Cay ( Z n, S). If there is pretty good plus state transfer from 1 2 a+ b , then n is divisible by 4 and pretty good plus state transfer occurs between 1 2 a+ b and 1 2 a+ n 4 + b+ .
